question: What happened on mobile in June?
text: Filter to mobile over June and July 2026: the checkout line reads 41% where it held 62% every other month, and the funnel's last step falls with it. That is the checkout bug, on 110 mobile sessions reaching checkout in June alone.

question: Was desktop hit too?
text: The same days on desktop: 55% checkout to purchase, no drop at all. The bug was mobile checkout, which is why the page keeps a device filter.
